notes.title: Mystik Belle has an unofficial Korean translation now?!
notes.notes:
Hey guys and gals,
[previewyoutube=6MiFGfmsRec;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] I have recently been looking for post-facelift Mystik Belle's gameplay videos for a presentation. Lo and behold, I stumbled upon 2 hour long video of my game being played entirely in Korean!
I have contacted the uploader and got a link to [url=https://blog.naver.com/bleach1491/221351608828]Wind Translation Club blog[/url], where it seems a full Korean translation of Mystik Belle has been available since September last year!
So this isn't even a new thing, huh?!



I'm both, flattered and surprised! I hope this will be useful to someone.

Meanwhile, I'll have to look into adding Workshop support my games exactly for this kind of thing.

Cheers.
Andrew.

notes.title: About the "floaty" thing...
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8811314/e3750dbeffb9c38542218ee895f666a416ecff3e.png[/img]

Hello guys and gals!
With Belle releasing on consoles, the game finally got a bit of the attention from the mainstream audience, and with that began a new wave of complaints about its "floaty" jumps. Personally, I prefer the slower, more controlled jumps, but this seems to be an unpopular opinion. Therefore I have updated the [b]Beta branch[/b] of the game with, among other things, a new, quicker jump for Belle. Let's hope it's more to everyone's liking.

Here's what's new in RC5A59:

[list]
[*] Changed player gravity to minimize "floaty" complaints.
[*] Changed how double-jump works. Can now be executed at any point of the trajectory.
[*] Minor platform tweaks across the map to eliminate close call jumps and just-out-of-reach ledges.
[*] Replaced player walk animation with a jog to make it look "faster".
[*] Lowered some of the enemy HP early in the game to make them less annoying to take out with Belle's base shot.
[*] Added item name popups - the pickup names should be located at index $$371, otherwise default names are used.
[*] Made the Turbo mode the game default (thinking of locking the game to Turbo and removing the option in future updates. What do you think?)
[*] Fixed up the 30 fps mode, as it's been falling by the wayside.
[*] Increased frog sleep timer by one second. Might not be enough.
[*] Fixed plant-shooter-platforms to spawn at consistent height.
[*] Some changes to Sinclair's portrait and model. Added another state for him during end-game.
[*] Fixed a bug with Bitterwarts, where her item collision could become picky.
[*] Fixed Skelebro's AI, so he wouldn't jump onto platforms, or flicker when backed into a corner.
[*] Added a few new sound effects.
[/list]

I'd love to hear if the new physics make the game better or worse. You can currently switch to the old jumping physics by pressing I in the debug mode.

Beta branch password is as usual nowheretorun

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8811314/cd444b0eaea4c94edaaccb3a14930a7ccbbc8796.gif[/img]

notes.title: Mystik Belle soundtrack available on BandCamp!
notes.notes:
[url=https://myoosic.bandcamp.com/releases][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8811314/a802f57bdf91e58cea5112f89cc3992e040bd0a0.png[/img][/url]

Just in case you didn't know, Dan Rogers' amazing chiptune soundtrack is available on [url=https://myoosic.bandcamp.com/releases]BandCamp[/url] for the low-low price of whatever you feel like!

Also, the main branch of the game has received a minor update.
[list]
[*] Added support for D-Pads on (legacy) Direct Input controllers.
[*] Added a brand new VFX for collecting items.
[*] Added a short animated clue when passing by the Raccoon lair for the first time
[*] Added a subtle indication of the Raccoon lair if a stolen item is inside.
[*] Re-spaced the uncensured English dialogue to minimize the "wall of text" effect.
[*] Added the E10 versions of Spanish, German and Italian languages.
[*] Fixed a minor bug with item-combination.
[/list]

For those adventurous enough to mess with the WIP DLC scenario, not much has changed.
[list]
[*] The map has been restructured, with new rooms added and some old ones removed.
[*] 2 new enemies added.
[*] 1 new prop added. It can't be interacted with yet.
[/list]

I have finally figured out some design choices for the first DLC, such as the story basics and the first major puzzle. Now to implement it!: )

[/list]

notes.title: A big animation and parallax update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8811314/b475c77e46ee36ef0c2d2a491feee3f583c78906.gif[/img]

Something I always wanted Belle to have was custom animations for all her puzzle solutions. Unfortunately, at the time of the game's release I had to write these off as an impossible luxury.
However, with this update the game moves a few steps closer to my original goal! Now many of the game's puzzle solutions will be accompanied by a silly player animation.

Also, I have nicely spruced up the game's foreground layers with more detail, and added a nifty pseudo-3D floor effect to a few rooms.

Oh, and there's been lots and lots of bug-fixes all over the place, hopefully improving the overall gaming experience.

notes.title: Warp chests and Easier mode
notes.notes:
Mystic Belle's Beta branch has been updated with a new build, introducing some pretty radical new features.
First of these is the introduction of the difficulty select at the start of the game. The player will no longer be able to flip the difficulty at will during gameplay, as the modes are a bit more different now.
Second major feature is the addition of warp chests. These are only available on the easier setting. The chests allow you to store up to 14 inventory items in them, which will be available in all other chests around the game's world.
This should resolve at least some of the woes caused by the game's limited inventory space, as anywhere you go, there is likely to be a chest nearby.

Beta branch password is "nowheretorun"

notes.title: If you thought the game was too slow...
notes.notes:
I have added a Game Speed option to Mystic Belle!
The feature is currently in beta, and will allow any player to change the game's absolute speed between 50% and 150% of normal. The setting can only be changed from the main menu, as changing it during gameplay can cause unpredictable behavior.

You can access the newest version of Belle on the Beta branch, with password "nowheretorun".

Cheers!

notes.title: Mystik Belle 60fps framerate boost update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8811314/b475c77e46ee36ef0c2d2a491feee3f583c78906.gif[/img]
As a game developed in GameMaker: Studio, Mystik Belle has been initially released locked to the framerate of 30fps. I have since learned the error of my ways, embracing the light of PC Master Race: )
The game has been overhauled in order to play at a far more acceptable 60 fps!

Here are the changes in the new version RC5A37:
[list]
[*] Added a main menu option to switch between 30 and 60 fps.
[*] Moved all control-related options into the Controls sub-menu.
[*] Added ability to map the dash function to a button!
[*] Added a Game Over-like screen. When playing on the Easier difficulty, this screen allows the player to restart the current location.
[*] Added lots of new sound effects for things that should've always had sound effects, but didn't.
[*] Added controller vibration function.
[*] Added an electric lift shortcut to the dumpster room.
[*] Re-balanced all of the boss fights.
[*] Added some new Belle animation.
[*] Added a UTF-8 font mode for Asian localization. A very incomplete Japanese translation is included with the build (anyone wants to help drive it home?: )
[*] Toned down some of the swearing in the Russian localization.
[*] Lots and lots of fixes and improvements across the board.
[*] Possibly new bugs, but hopefully not.
[/list]

Note: Sadly I am temporarily unable to update the Mac version of the game due to changes to OSX and introduction of mandatory developer fees. I will resume Mac updates once I have the money to pay Apple their ransom. A massive apology to my Mac customers.

notes.title: Mystik Belle Update #2 now with 30% more Nicky
notes.notes:
Hello guys and gals,
Tonight I have released another semi-major update to my game. In addition to a cumulative bug-fix, the patch addresses a number of gameplay complaints.
First and foremost, the dash condition has been loosened, but in such a way as to prevent unwanted activations. I hope this kind of a change works for everyone.
The second change is also dash-related. The forest hall with the Soviet Bear at the bottom, no longer requires the players to air-dash all the way across, instead providing some new obstacles to be navigated around.
New effects and animations have been added to  Franky's room and puzzle trigger scene.
Lastly - a few new character interaction scenes have been added late in the game for both, Franky and Nicky. While Franky can still be found napping in his basement lab, Nicky will be in her bunk at the dorms. Her dialogue is heavily dependent on your previous interactions. notes.title: Mystik Belle controls update is here
notes.notes:
Hey guy and gals!
Tonight I have posted the game's first major update. It includes various big fixes and aesthetic changes here and there.

The biggest change is the ability to define Item menu and Interact to different buttons, as well as the ability to redefine controller keys right from inside the game. This even includes legacy controller support, though since those have no clearly defined button labels, no button representation will show.
